rows.description: Enhanced Quote List View and Search within Opportunities
rows.next_steps:
Use case: while Opening the Opportunity seeing all Sales quotes only Cards available;Table View REquired
No timeline  yet - Yogesh will check to see if it is planned or not ( low number of votes)
rows.comments:
Use case: Use Case 3: Enhanced Quote List View and Search within Opportunities
Description
Users require an improved way of viewing and searching related Quotes within an Opportunity.
Context / Problem
Opportunities represent tender objects where multiple Quotes are created for different installers.
Currently, Quotes are displayed in a Kanban view.
With many related quotes, the Kanban view becomes inefficient for navigation and search.
Key Requirements
Provide an alternative table/list view for Quotes within an Opportunity.
Enable search and filtering capabilities within this view.
Allow filtering by relevant fields such as:
Account
Owner
Dates
(Potentially other key attributes)
Expected Outcome / Value
Easier navigation through large sets of related Quotes.
Faster identification of relevant quotes.
Improved usability and transparency in tender management.
 
Use Case : Global / Advanced Search for Account Involvement
Description
Users need to identify all Opportunities in which a specific Account is involved, regardless of the role the account plays.
Context / Problem
Accounts can be related to Opportunities in multiple ways (e.g., Ship-To, Bill-To, or custom roles).
Current search/filter capabilities do not easily allow users to view all Opportunities tied to an Account across all roles.
This creates inefficiencies when trying to understand full account engagement.
Key Requirements
Introduce an advanced or global search/filter capability.
Allow filtering Opportunities by Account involvement, independent of role type.
Ensure the filter includes all relationship types (standard + custom roles).
Expected Outcome / Value
Full visibility of account-related business activities.
Easier account analysis.
Improved decision-making and customer management.

Enable Dynamic User-Based Filters and Increase Cards/Filter Limits in SAP Sales and Service Cloud
rows.comments: We request the ability to create dynamic filters for Cards based on the currently logged-in user in SAP Sales and Service Cloud. Today, filters used by Cards cannot reference the current user dynamically. As a result, administrators must create a separate filter for each individual user, even when the Card logic is identical. In our scenario, we need the same Card for 24 users, which requires creating 24 nearly identical filters. However, we have reached the current limit of 10 filters. Additionally, we are concerned that there may also be a limit on the number of Cards that can be created, which would further restrict this approach. The preferred solution would be to introduce a dynamic value such as "Current User" that can be used in Card filters. If this is not feasible, the maximum number of filters and Cards should be increased or removed.

rows.description: Determination Rule on Opportunity does not re-trigger when source custom field on Account is updated
rows.comments: if the Account's custom field has a different value at Opportunity creation and is later changed directly on the Account, the already existing Opportunity does not pick up this change. The Determination Rule only appears to evaluate at Opportunity creation time and is not re-triggered by subsequent updates to the source field on the Account. We request that Determination Rules be enhanced, or that a supported alternative mechanism be provided, so that a change to the source custom field on the Account can also update the corresponding field on already existing, related Opportunities, and not only on new Opportunities created afterward. In C4C V1, Extension Scenarios were able to fulfill this kind of requirement, keeping fields in sync across related objects even after creation.

rows.description: Support for 'Display IDs' for related entities within Opportunity import/export
rows.comments: requesting to support of 'Display Ids'. For opportunity data import/export, the related entities to support of using 'Display IDs' instead of UUIDs. For Account, it is only supported to input the UUID of the account.
